newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev extends losses to near peg target.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev extends losses to near peg target.

text.p: The lev closed at 988-991 per mark, down from the opening's 984-986, moving towards the planned peg at a fixed exchange rate of 1,000 to the mark under a currency board system from July 1, dealers said.
* The lev also eased against the dollar, trading at 1,703-1,705 at the close against the morning's 1,690-1,695 in line with the lev/mark and the international mark/dollar cross.
* Foreign currency demand was high as yield on foreign exchange investments was seen higher than yield on government securities in the period to July 1.

* The average yield to maturity on four-week discount T-bills, issued daily by the Finance Ministry, fell to 0.40 percent on Wednesday from 0.42 at Tuesday's auction, 0.47 percent on Monday and 0.58 percent on Friday.

* Traders said the local currency was expected to lose 10-12 levs against the mark in the remaining three working days until July 1 to fit gradually into the fixed exchange rate. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 91188
